exposure: Duration of sperm exposure with the biological father (short duration: <= 3 months, long duration: >= 12 months)
cohort: The study included 502 single birth primigravid women from Women's Hospital, School of Medicine, Zhejiang University.
finding: A long duration of sperm exposure with the biological father was associated with a reduced incidence of preeclampsia, especially in women aged 30 years and older.
